analyticalQuestion: Does the exact projective heat identity provide the weighted-BV budget, or do angular growth, cutoff source saturation, and the two-power frequency gap remain?
supportedClaim: Pure heat has an exact projective-curvature payment identity. The fixed-energy 2D3C family has unbounded initial pointwise angular speed but finite limiting source density. The fixed cutoff quotients remain finite. The direct weighted-BV Young estimate loses two powers of frequency against the known heat-bulk weight.
claimBoundary: Closed-form identities, exact initial-time Fourier algebra, and scaling comparison only; no DNS, fitted data, general integrated angular no-go, regularity theorem, singularity claim, originality claim, or Millennium-problem claim.
